load_weight_into_column_parallel_paramet: load weight data into a column-parallel parameter by narrowing and copying from loaded tensor
load_weight_into_row_parallel_parameter: load weight data into a row-parallel parameter by narrowing and copying from loaded tensor
load_qkv_weight_with_sharding: load qkv weight data into parameter with shard offset, shard size, shard id and num heads arguments
adjust_shard_indexes_for_packing: adjust shard size and shard offset for packed weights accounting for packed factor and marlin tile size
permute_param_layout: permute a parameter's tensor layout to specified input and output dimensions while preserving packed dim
